text: The land-change method was unable to evaluate the property due to insufficient evidence. The necessary source coverage for the asset has not been prepared, and no observations were made using the available sources like Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020, and MGAP 2021. Therefore, this evidence does not support any conclusions about tree-cover loss within the asset during the specified interval. It neither confirms nor denies the occurrence of tree-cover loss or any regulatory compliance findings.
